parakeet: This is religious colonization. Christianity wasn't just about faith, it was about empire. European explorers carried the Bible in one hand and the sword in the other. Indigenous cultures were told their gods were false and their traditions demonic. Entire civilizations were destroyed in the name of Jesus. And today, this same doctrine fuels evangelical movements that view saving souls as a moral duty. Religious groups that infiltrate governments to enforce biblical laws? Christian nationalism that seeks to impose religious dominance. Jesus didn't bring peace, he brought an ideology that demanded control. And if your faith can't survive without forcing others to follow it, was it ever about truth or was it always about power? So what does all this mean?
